verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform, not an agent that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence never shows Tailscale plugging in MCP servers to use their tools. tsidp only secures access to MCP servers, and Aperture is an LLM gateway and agent launcher; neither is documented as an MCP client, so neither flips the axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
